itr_form_reasoning: Only salary income and income from other sources (dividend + savings interest), total income well under Rs 50 lakh, no capital gains realised this year (only dividends, no share sales), single house property (none owned). ITR-1 (Sahaj) applies.

regime_comparison.note: New regime wins decisively: total income (Rs 8,48,340) is below the Rs 12,00,000 section 87A rebate threshold for FY2025-26, so slab tax of Rs 24,834 is fully rebated to nil. Old regime, even after Rs 50,000 80C (EPF), gives taxable income Rs 8,23,340 and tax of Rs 80,260 because its 87A rebate threshold is only Rs 5,00,000.

deductions_claimed.note: 80C/80D not claimed under new regime as they are not allowed (except 80CCD(2))
